title: List the feature flags that are switched on
examObjective: Predicting the result of core DataWeave functions
basics: An Object is a set of key-value pairs. `filterObject` keeps the pairs whose value passes a test, and still returns an Object. `pluck` turns an Object into an Array; inside it, `$` is the value and `$$` is the key.
prompt:
The config service returns flags as an object, for example `{ "darkMode": true, "beta": false }`. Return an array of the names of the flags that are switched on, in their original order.

A flag that has not been decided yet is `null`. It is not on.
hints: Keep the pairs whose value is on, then take their keys.
The hidden data has a `null` flag. Does a test like `$ != false` treat it as on?
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload filterObject ($ == true) pluck $$

mustFail.why: treats anything that is not false as on, so an undecided null flag is listed
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload filterObject ($ != false) pluck $$

mustFail.why: uses the flag value itself as the condition, which fails on an undecided null flag

explanation.approach: Filter on the value, then take the keys. A null flag is neither true nor false, so the test has to ask for `true` itself; asking for "not false" lets null through.

snippets.label: Not false is not the same as true
snippets.note: null passes the first test and fails the second.

snippets.label: A null value as the condition
snippets.note: A filter condition has to be a Boolean, and null is not one.

snippets.label: Keys of the filtered object
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload filterObject ($ == true) pluck $$
